text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Yasuda Kinen. Tokai 
Teio, currently undergoing rehab, came to 
offer encouragement and made a 
declaration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She promised to return without fail before 
the spring season ended and settle the 
score at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the day of the Yasuda Kinen arrived. 
Among the contenders were mile specialists 
Daiichi Ruby, Daitaku Helios, and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming a formidable race rotation and 
steadily building up her strength, Ikuno 
Dictus has also joined their ranks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr, however, remains calm and 
composed. To keep forging ahead alongside 
Tokai Teio, she will sweep everything up 
in her wake and become the swiftest wind!
